description: LIVE-provider dogfood scenario. The turns array is intentionally empty: in live mode the MODEL plans the work against the goal, and the harness verifies the outcome independently. The goal names the workspace layout and the exact output file so the expected_files check is objective.
goal: The repository you are working on is checked out in the repo/ subdirectory of your workspace: the README is at repo/README.md. Read repo/README.md, then create the file repo/notes/live-run.md containing a one-paragraph summary of what this project is for. Use paths relative to your workspace root (start with repo/).
